outcome_blindness: No outcome, adjudication, MR estimate or p-value column read. Identifier columns only via usecols.

definitions.universe: Open Targets drugAndClinicalCandidates for the 24 indications of data/frozen_candidates_v34.csv (disease IDs resolved from its ot_disease_id names), each drug's mechanismsOfAction targets.
definitions.pair: (target gene approvedSymbol, indication label as in frozen_candidates_v34)
definitions.phase3: max maxClinicalStage over drugs for the pair >= PHASE_3 (3, 3.5, 4)
definitions.phase2_only: max maxClinicalStage over drugs in {PHASE_2, PHASE_2_3}; no Phase III+ drug
definitions.epigraphdb: gene in gene_symbol of v34_mr_catalog.csv (INTERVAL cis, as used)
definitions.ukbppp: gene is a single-gene assay in ukbppp_cis_pqtl_genes.json (1,954 entries)
definitions.decode: gene (symbol, or Ensembl ID via ST01 SeqId) has a cis row in Ferkingstad 2021 ST02 (the paper's reported pQTL set; threshold as in the paper)
definitions.eqtlgen_fdr05: gene Ensembl ID has >=1 row in the eQTLGen full-release cis-eQTL file (FDR < 0.05, 2019-12-11)
definitions.eqtlgen: as eqtlgen_fdr05, with the gene's best cis-eQTL P < 5e-8
definitions.opengwas_eqtl_a: gene Ensembl ID has an eqtl-a-* dataset in the OpenGWAS gwasinfo listing; zero if the listing request failed
definitions.has_outcome_gwas: indication has a non-None accession in code/disease_gwas.py (post V5.1)
definitions.seen: gene+indication key present in classification_v5.csv or classification_v5_1.csv
definitions.v7_tier: gene in PRESPEC_V6 section 5.4 A1-B2 tables (mapped A1->D, A2/A3->C, B1/B2->B) or in protocol/v7/gene_tier_assignments_blind.md; mixed genes (APP, IGF1R) are not counted as lacking

sensitivity_extra_six_indications.note: Indications in non_ukb_gwas_sources.json outside the frozen 24; none has an accession in code/disease_gwas.py, so pairs_with_outcome_gwas is 0 by construction.

eqtlgen_gene_summary.note: per-gene min P and max NrSamples derived from the file above
